# https://kprompt.ai/llms.txt
# Guidance for AI assistants and crawlers about kprompt.
# Full docs dump: https://kprompt.ai/llms-full.txt

> kprompt is The AI Runtime for Kubernetes: observe → reason → plan → validate → approve → execute → learn. Open-source CLI compiles natural language into a reviewable PlanResult; optional Observe agent for always-on namespace alerts. Apache-2.0. Experimental. Local kubeconfig + BYOK — no cluster credentials uploaded by default. Never silent auto-heal.

## Positioning (honest)
- Category: AI Runtime for Kubernetes — not a ChatGPT wrapper, not a generic workflow engine, not a Kubernetes chatbot.
- Not McKinsey ARK (Agentic Runtime): ARK hosts agent apps as CRDs on K8s; kprompt reasons about cluster ops under plan → approve. See https://kprompt.ai/blog/kprompt-vs-ark
- Not kagent (CNCF agent platform): Agents/MCP/A2A on the cluster vs PlanResult ops CLI + Observe. See https://kprompt.ai/blog/kprompt-vs-kagent
- Same NL-CLI lane as kubectl-ai for day-2 mutate; different contract (plan → safety → approve) plus in-cluster Observe path.
- Not a K8sGPT fleet scanner; not a hosted Lens clone.
- Optional in-cluster Observe agent (Helm): namespace watch → Incident → gated notify.
- Autopilot (ADR-0015) is propose-only by default — never silent apply.
- Shipped v0.10.0 (AI Runtime closure, ADR-0023): closed Learn loop, policy-gated Autopilot apply, continuous Coordinator (proactive tick + opt-in mesh/OTel blast-radius + durable outcome ring), topology Knowledge Graph edges, Incident→PlanResult bridge, durable cluster memory — default stays propose-only.
- Building / next: deeper multi-agent reasoning, Secret-value/external-API Knowledge Graph + topology UI, sandbox/chaos Simulation — do not claim as shipped.
- Long-term direction: continuous reasoning under the same approval DNA — see roadmap.
